'''Pyrewood Elders''' are [[human]]s found in [[Pyrewood Village]] in [[Silverpine Forest]]. At night, they transform into their [[worgen]] form as '''[[Moonrage Elder]]s'''.

==Abilities==
* '''Lesser Heal''' — Heal your target for 143 to 165.
* '''Shadow Word: Pain''' — A word of darkness that causes 60 Shadow damage over 18 sec.

==Objective of==
* Drop [[Pyrewood Shackle]] for {{questlong|Horde|15+|Arugal's Folly (4)|Arugal's Folly}}.

==Notes==
* They are affiliated with [[Stormwind (faction)|Stormwind]] during daytime to make them unattackable by Alliance players.
